Before moving to the UK, I worked as an accountant in Iran — a career that gave me real discipline around precision and process. When I arrived here, I made a deliberate decision to go after what actually excites me. Everything in this portfolio was made at home, in my own time, while working in professional kitchens and building the foundations of a pastry career. The range here — from hand-rolled confections to chocolate roulades to savoury flatbreads — reflects the breadth of what I enjoy making and keep coming back to.
